title: An AI-Driven Assistant for Human-Centric Building Digital Twin Systems: Design, Implementation, and Comparative User Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22350v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Smart buildings generate streams of operational data, yet this richness rarely translates into accessible, decision-ready information for stakeholders who inhabit and manage them. Current Building Digital Twin Systems (BDTS) often remain oriented toward technical specialists and rely on static, one-size-fits-all interfaces. This paper presents the design, implementation, and comparative user evaluation of an AI-driven conversational assistant integrated into a human-centric BDTS for Indoor Environmental Quality monitoring, combined with adaptive information presentation and auto-suggest functionality. The prototype was deployed at New York University Abu Dhabi. A controlled, two-arm, between-subjects, quasi-experimental study with wave-based, non-randomized assignment compared the Baseline interface with the Experimental interface. translated_abstract: 智能建筑会产生持续不断的运营数据流，然而这些丰富的数据很少能转化为可供建筑居住者和管理者轻松获取、可直接用于决策的信息。当前的建筑数字孪生系统（BDTS）通常面向技术专家，并依赖于静态的、千篇一律的界面。本文介绍了一个集成于以人为本的BDTS中的AI驱动对话助手的设计、实现与对比用户评估，该系统用于室内环境质量监测，并结合了自适应信息呈现与自动建议功能。该原型部署于纽约大学阿布扎比分校。研究采用受控的双组、受试者间准实验设计，通过基于波次的非随机分组方式，将基线界面与实验界面进行了对比。结果显示，实验界面显著降低了任务完成时间和感知工作负荷，而准确性和……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文设计并实现了集成于以人为本建筑数字孪生系统中、用于室内环境质量监测的AI对话助手，用户对比实验表明其能显著缩短任务完成时间并降低感知工作负荷。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an AI-driven conversational assistant integrated into a human-centric Building Digital Twin System for indoor environmental quality monitoring, with comparative user evaluation showing significant reductions in task-completion time and perceived workload.
